requirements.text: System must create an order from the shopping cart
System must cancel an order before payment
System must send an order confirmation email

code_entities.name: create_order_from_cart
code_entities.docstring: Create a new order based on the cart contents

code_entities.name: calculate_vat
code_entities.docstring: Calculate VAT tax for an order

code_entities.name: apply_discount_code
code_entities.docstring: Apply a discount code to the order total

code_entities.name: calculate_shipping_cost
code_entities.docstring: Compute shipping cost for the order

code_entities.name: cancel_order
code_entities.docstring: Cancel an order if payment has not been processed

code_entities.name: send_order_confirmation_email
code_entities.docstring: Send an order confirmation email to the customer
